refs.quote: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE TRILEPTAL is indicated for use as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial-onset seizures in adults

2.1 Adjunctive Therapy for Adults Initiate TRILEPTAL with a dose of 600 mg/day, given twice a day. If clinically indicated, the dose may be increased by a maximum of 600 mg/day at approximately weekly intervals; the maximum recommended daily dose is 1200 mg/day.

regimens.dose_text: Initiate at 300 mg twice daily (600 mg/day). Titrate by up to 600 mg/day at approximately weekly intervals to recommended target of 1200 mg/day (max 2400 mg/day).

refs.quote: In patients with impaired renal function (creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min), initiate TRILEPTAL at one-half the usual starting dose (300 mg/day, given twice a day), and increase slowly to achieve the desired clinical response [ see Clinical Pharmacology (12. 3 ) ].
